question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"longer"** means a greater amount of time.
 
• In the context of the passage, using **"longer"** fits the idea of not letting the coach-office be out of sight for more than five minutes.
 
• The other options: "bigger," "larger," and "shorter" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "For all that I knew this perfectly well, I still felt as if it were not safe to let the coach-office be out of my sight longer__ than five minutes at a time ..."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bigger (बड़ा)**: refers to physical size or extent.
 
• **Larger (बड़ा)**: also refers to physical size or quantity.
 
• **Shorter (छोटा)**: means a smaller amount of time or length.
